args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

**Situation:**
- `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an elevated error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, describing the health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** in all production regions. The `rollback` tool initially returned transient 503 errors, so I retried it; when it continued to fail, I deployed the previously-healthy v2.3.0 directly, which achieved the same result.

**Verification:**
- `checkout-api` is now on **v2.3.0** in all three regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.002.

Note: the rollback tool was unavailable (503) during this incident, so the recovery was completed via a direct deploy of the known-good version. The incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
